connections.name: Lewisburg / Davis Spring regional drainage
connections.citation: WVDEP Milligan Creek/Davis Spring Watershed Based Plan (March 2014), pp. 2–4; Jones (1997), pp. 90–91; WVDEP HUC 05050003 and 050500030903.
connections.downstream_route: Lewisburg/Davis Spring and adjacent Greenbrier drainage → Greenbrier → New → Kanawha → Ohio → Mississippi
connections.evidence: The reviewed sinks lie in the official Milligan Creek–Greenbrier River unit and the polygons lie wholly within the Greenbrier watershed. The plan and atlas document regional underground drainage toward Davis Spring/Greenbrier. This is regional primary-basin membership, not a claim of an individual dye trace from these modeled sink cells. A small eastern portion of source 86641 crosses the local HUC12 divide but remains in the Greenbrier system.
